seo.title: The Addison of Boca Raton · Weddings, Mitzvahs & Celebrations
seo.description: Weddings, bar & bat mitzvahs and celebrations at The Addison of Boca Raton: Addison Mizner's 1925 landmark, ceremonies beneath century-old banyans, up to 250 guests and Glatt Kosher catering under ORB supervision. Production by Avinu Events.

hero.lead: Addison Mizner’s 1925 landmark: ceremonies beneath century-old banyans, rooms for up to 250 guests, and a Glatt Kosher kitchen supervised by the ORB.

paras: Built by architect Addison Mizner in 1925 as the administration building for his Boca Raton development, The Addison still carries the arches, courtyards and old-Florida glamour of the era.
Today it hosts weddings, bar and bat mitzvahs and milestone celebrations, with an event manager and an in-house kitchen coordinating every detail.

items.label: Weddings
items.title: Weddings
items.text: Exchange vows beneath century-old banyans, then move into the rooms of Mizner’s landmark for dinner and dancing, without leaving the property.
points: Ceremony, cocktails and reception on one property
Ceremony music, DJ and lighting by Avinu Events

items.label: Bar & Bat Mitzvahs
items.title: Bar & Bat Mitzvahs
items.text: A Glatt Kosher kitchen under ORB supervision, and a courtyard that turns into a dance floor after dark.
points: Glatt Kosher menus supervised by the ORB
Courtyard and indoor rooms for the party and the lounge
DJ, MC, dancers and LED by Avinu Events

items.label: Galas & Social
items.title: Galas & social events
items.text: Black-tie dinners, milestone birthdays and corporate evenings, with plated service, entrées chosen at the table and wine poured tableside.
points: Stage sound, projection and lighting by Avinu Events
items.cta: Plan an event at The Addison

film.h2: From the banyans to the dance floor
film.text: Ceremony beneath the trees, dinner under the glass roof and a courtyard that glows after dark. Choose a moment to see the property change.

spaces.text: Reserve a single room or the whole estate, with exclusive use of the courtyard and gardens.

items.name: The Courtyard
items.text: Century-old banyan trees and a cascading fountain, for ceremonies, cocktail hours and dinners under the sky.

items.name: The Hall
items.text: A glass-roofed hall with room for dinner, a dance floor and hanging florals.

items.name: Private Rooms
items.text: Wood-panelled and arched-window rooms for rehearsal dinners, showers and intimate celebrations.

spaces.note: Up to 250 guests seated across the property. Room-by-room capacities and floor plans available from the venue.

cuisine.h2: Elevated cuisine, Glatt Kosher when you need it
paras: The Addison’s in-house kitchen, led by Executive Chef Patrick Duffy, plates every course to order, with entrées chosen at the table and wine poured tableside.
For kosher celebrations, a Glatt Kosher program supervised by the Orthodox Rabbinical Board (ORB) has earned a Five Star Diamond Award.
highlights: Diamond Award for Glatt Kosher catering

reviews.kicker: Couples and families who celebrated here
reviews.src: Reviews from WeddingWire and Bark · Rating from Google

items.q: The outdoor ceremony space, framed by stunning banyan trees, completely transports you.
What stood out the most was the service. Everyone is super friendly and helpful.
We had our daughters bat mitzvah here and it was amazing.

production.text: Avinu Events produces the entertainment for celebrations across South Florida, from Boca Raton to Miami: the music for the ceremony, the energy of the dance floor and the light that shapes the room.
production.lighting: Uplighting on the Mizner arches, pin-spotting and courtyard lighting designed around the property.
